ops.title: capt-hook test scoping + HOME sandbox shipped (b28312b5)
ops.body:
Shipped to main as b28312b5 (2026-07-20); CI, Documentation, and Guides workflows all green. Resolves the getaway papercut entry in the papercuts journal (119a273, 2026-07-19): the foreign getaway pack no longer fails `capt-hook --hooks docs/examples test`.

New `capt-hook test` semantics (CliState.discover(scope=...) in captain_hook/cli.py): bare `test` covers the hooks dir plus packs declared in `.claude/capt-hook.toml`; `--hooks DIR` covers only that dir and skips pack resolution entirely; packs shipped by installed Claude Code plugins are never tested (their own repos test them). `run`/`hooks`/the daemon keep full discovery.

Inline tests now execute under a per-run scratch HOME (riding isolated_state_root in testing/helpers.py) with `pinned_caches()` pinning XDG_CACHE_HOME and WN_DATA_DIR to their REAL locations, captured before any HOME swap. Never scratch those two vars: spaCy raises for uvx consumers on a cache miss and wn re-downloads the ~231MB oewn lexicon into a doomed tmpdir. Per-fixture FileFixture(home=True) dirs keep precedence; the replay branch sandboxes only the replay drive — session lookup stays on real HOME.

Ship saga: origin/main had moved underneath the wave (10.5.0 released + the cc-transcript v14.6 migration), so `ccx vcs ship` rolled back on rebase conflicts. Resolved via an isolated worktree cherry-pick onto origin/main — CHANGELOG got a fresh [Unreleased] above the released 10.5.0 section (the release had consumed the section my bullets targeted). A mid-push reboot vaporized the /tmp worktree; the amended commit survived in the shared object store and was pushed by ref afterward.

CONTAMINATION NOTICE for the concurrent captain-hook session: the file-scoped commit cut at ship time swept in a foreign hunk — the hardened `test_dead_shebang_claude_caches_empty_roster` (fallback_calls assertion) landed in tests/test_plugin_packs.py between my review pass and the ship. That hunk depends on the still-uncommitted packs/plugins.py WIP (it fails against upstream plugins.py), so it was STRIPPED from the pushed commit. It still rides in LOCAL commit 31d1cd3e in the shared checkout's jj stack (under @); ship it together with the plugins.py fix. Transferable lesson: before a file-scoped ship from a shared working copy, re-diff the files at ship time — review-time diffs go stale while other sessions work.

Deferred follow-up: getaway's hand-rolled CI hermeticity incantation (`HOME="$(mktemp -d)" uvx capt-hook --hooks hooks --root "$(mktemp -d)" test --json`) can drop once a capt-hook release ships this; the release tag remains user-gated per repo convention.
